description: Implementation of a real-time text-to-speech service using LMNT's WebSocket API, including connection management, message handling, and TTS streaming.

classes.name: LmntTTSService
classes.description: A class implementing a real-time TTS service using LMNT's WebSocket API, supporting streaming audio, connection management, and error handling.

methods.name: language_to_lmnt_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to an LMNT language code string.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the LMNT TTS service with API key, voice, language, model, and other settings.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to LMNT-specific language code.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.start
methods.description: Starts the TTS service and establishes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS and disconnects WebSocket.

methods.name: LmntTTSService.push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame downstream, handling stop/interruption frames.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection to LMNT and starts message handler.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects WebSocket and cleans up tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Handles WebSocket connection setup and initial message exchange.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and stops metrics.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns current WebSocket connection or raises error if not connected.

methods.name: flush_audio
methods.description: Sends a flush command to WebSocket to process pending audio.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Asynchronously receives and processes messages from WebSocket.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech audio from text via streaming WebSocket, yielding audio frames.
